style: Children's picture-book illustration like a printed storybook: a 2D digital painting with clean dark outlines, soft painted shading, warm bright colors, large expressive eyes, and rounded friendly shapes. Not 3D, not a render, not a photo. Body proportions: a child of 7 to 9 is about 4.5 heads tall; an adult is about 6.5 heads tall.
sheet: Character reference sheet: one character only, full body, standing straight, front view, arms relaxed at the sides, centered, on a plain white background, with a soft shadow under the feet. No words, letters, or numbers.
rules: Describe the eyes (dark brown for every character, Daniel 2026-10-01), hair, and clothes. Never describe skin color or ethnicity (Daniel, 2026-10-01). People keep the printed picture-book look. Each look is complete: age and height against the other characters, eyes, hair, every clothing item with its color, and shoes.

characters.name: pip
characters.description: Pip, a small puppy with golden-brown fur, a cream chest, a cream muzzle, and a cream stripe on his forehead. He has floppy ears with darker tips, large dark-brown eyes, a black nose, a fluffy tail, and a red collar with a small round gold tag. He is about as tall as a child's knee. He stands on four legs and smiles with his mouth open.

He has floppy ears with darker tips, large dark-brown eyes, a black nose, a fluffy tail, and a red collar with a small round gold tag. He is about as tall as a child's knee.

characters.name: squeaky
characters.description: Squeaky, a small mouse with soft light-brown fur and a cream belly. He has big round pink ears, a pink nose, white whiskers, large dark-brown eyes, two small front teeth, and a long thin pink tail. He wears no clothes. He is about as tall as a teacup. He stands on his back legs and smiles.

characters.name: tom
characters.description: Tom, a nine-year-old boy, one of the tallest children, with a slim build. He has large dark-brown eyes and short brown hair swept to one side over his forehead, with a small tuft at the crown. He wears a blue T-shirt with wide orange and dark-blue stripes, green shorts, white ankle socks, and gray sneakers with white soles. He smiles with his mouth open.
